descripcion: Supervivencia de terror animada y narrada por días, en lugares reales de Latinoamérica. Caricatura vectorial con fondos pintados de noche (morado, azul y negro, luz naranja de la linterna). Protagonista fijo: Mateo, stickman con bandana roja, mochila y linterna (el «tú» de la voz). La amenaza solo en silueta. Sin sangre ni heridas.
bloque_estilo: STYLE: polished 2D vector cartoon, thick clean black outlines, soft cel shading, glossy highlights. Simple stickman characters in front of detailed, atmospheric, semi-realistic painted backgrounds. Night-time horror mood: deep purple, navy and black palette, warm orange light from the flashlight, windows and fires, cold blue moonlight, light ground fog. Threats are shown as silhouettes, shadows, glowing eyes or partially hidden figures, never fully lit. Latin American locations with recognizable details (colonial houses with balconies, mountain towns, Medellín metro, supermarket aisles, apartment towers, coffee farms).
personaje_por_defecto: a white stickman with a big round white head, spiky messy black hair, a bright red bandana tied around his forehead with two long red tails flowing behind, large expressive brown eyes, thin white stick body and limbs, white cartoon-glove hands, a small brown backpack, holding a black flashlight with a warm orange-yellow glow

elenco.Valentina: VALENTINA: a white stickman girl with a big round white head, long black hair in a high ponytail, a green military jacket, a first-aid pouch on her belt, determined eyebrows.
elenco.Don Rubén: DON RUBÉN: an older white stickman with a big round white head, gray mustache, bald top with gray sides, a brown poncho (ruana), a wooden cane, kind but tired eyes.
elenco.Canela: CANELA: a small cartoon street dog, caramel-brown fur, floppy ears, a red collar, very loyal and alert.
